q-dft-tap-trace.prompt: Starting in an unknown TAP state, trace this exact fixture on successive TCK rising edges. TMS is `1,1,1,1,1, 0,1,1,0,0, 0,0,0,1, 1,0, 1,0,0, 0,0,1, 1,0`. During the four Shift-IR sampling edges, TDI is `1,0,1,0` LSB-first; during the three Shift-DR sampling edges, TDI is `1,1,0` LSB-first. Determine when the controller reaches Test-Logic-Reset, captures, shifts, and updates the instruction and data registers. Trace the state entered on every TCK rising edge, and declare the convention used for TDI sampling and TDO change timing. State all assumptions that materially affect correctness; do not rely on undisclosed vendor behavior or confidential interview knowledge.
q-dft-tap-trace.promptZh: 从未知 TAP 状态开始，在连续的 TCK 上升沿逐拍追踪以下精确样例。TMS 为 `1,1,1,1,1, 0,1,1,0,0, 0,0,0,1, 1,0, 1,0,0, 0,0,1, 1,0`。四个 Shift-IR 采样边沿上的 TDI 按最低有效位优先为 `1,0,1,0`；三个 Shift-DR 采样边沿上的 TDI 按最低有效位优先为 `1,1,0`。判断控制器何时进入 Test-Logic-Reset，以及何时捕获、移位和更新指令寄存器与数据寄存器。列出每个 TCK 上升沿进入的状态，并声明所采用的 TDI 采样与 TDO 变化时序约定。说明所有对正确性有实质影响的假设；不得依赖未披露的厂商行为或保密的面试知识。
